title: Nifty 8/10 trade: Bull call spread 25850/26000 11:18
summary: Nifty crossed 25,800 with call writers unwinding two checks in a row and puts building behind. Bull call 25850/26000 at ~81, target 110, stop 62.
body_md: BUY 25850 CE @ ~309, SELL 26000 CE @ ~228, net ~81 (lot 65). Score 8/10: OI 3, learner 2, trend 1, R:R 1, room 1. Target 110 (~Rs 1,850/lot), stop 62 (~Rs 1,270/lot), max loss Rs 5,300/lot, breakeven 25,931 at expiry. Time exit 14:48. Analysis only, not trading advice.
